_comment: Marathon Maps · QtLocation OSM plugin tile_providers manifest.
Qt 6's stock OSM plugin defaults to https://maps-redirect.qt.io which
hands back Thunderforest tiles requiring a paid API key. We point the
plugin at this manifest instead via
so the active basemap is CARTO Dark Matter — a free OSM-derived dark
raster style (no key) that aligns with the Marathon DS map palette.
Future work: maplibre-native-qt + OpenFreeMap vector tiles.

tile_providers.MapDescription: CARTO Dark Matter · OSM dark style
